verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a first-party "PlanetScale Bot" that helps users get started, understand database performance, and fix slow or failing queries using its MCP server and skills. That is the closest thing to a delegable assistant in the pack, but nothing shows it is embedded in the dashboard; the URL suggests it may run on an external platform (Grok). The other agentic workflows rely on external agents (Claude, Cursor and other AI coding agents) connecting through the MCP server, so they are not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant in the dashboard, documented task delegation and its scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
